notes.title: Fantastic Findings Playtest 0.4.0.0 - Santa's Bakery; The Mill added.
notes.content:
Greetings folks!

A brand new level has been added - The Mill - 

Explore Santa's bakery and dig through a summer party to find the objects hidden within the level.
[list]
[*] All quest objects are included in the level.
[*] A quantity of art and animation is still work in progress
[*] Dirt items and gingerbread cookies are still pending.
[/list]

Please provide any feedback regarding the general difficulty in the level, if some objects are unobtainable - and feedback to the level in general!

[b]Change log:[/b]
Additional bugfixing on level 2 and 3.
Additional music track added.
Misc minor fixes

Have fun!

notes.title: Fantastic Findings 0.1.6

notes.title: We celebrate the 1st minor-major patch in Fantastic Findings - Hidden Seasons!
notes.content:
The first major content added:

Save system!
The first iteration of the main menu and level select! (No sound) WIP
Progression system, indicating picking up eatables + cleanup item and quest item progression

---------------------

If you wish to clear your progression; click the reset level button in the level select
Only 1 level playable so far

----------------------

Have fun!
